effects.name: End Effect

effects.effect: The bredbeddle can take two turns each round. They can't take turns consecutively.
effects.name: Solo Turns

effects.effect: While headless, the bredbeddle can move into a space containing a severed head and attach it to their neck as a main action. Doing so physically transforms the bredbeddle, who takes on the appearance, size, weight, and stability of the head's original owner. If the bredbeddle takes the form of a creature of size 1L or smaller, the distance of their melee and burst area abilities decreases by 1. These effects last until the bredbeddle is killed or beheaded, or until the head falls off after 24 hours. A head that falls off this way can no longer be attached to this bredbeddle.

A creature must succeed on a **hard Might test** made as a maneuver to rip a head off the bredbeddle. If they fail, the bredbeddle can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) against them.
The bredbeddle can't be physically transformed in any way except by their Heady or Not trait.
The bredbeddle [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to 2 squares, and can target additional enemies who come within distance of this ability during the shift.

effects.effect: A host creature implanted by a soulraker hivequeen's Stinging Ovipositor has no physical or mental signs of the handmaiden gestating inside the host's body.

After 1d3 + 1 weeks of gestation, the handmaiden fully forms inside the host. The handmaiden always moves with and occupies the same space as the host and can't be separated from them. While totally within the creature, the handmaiden doesn't have [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to the host or targets outside the host and vice versa. As a maneuver, the handmaiden can emerge from the host as a horrifying tower of flesh and bone that remains attached to the host's insides. While emerged, the handmaiden can use a move action to make the host move up to their speed and has access to the host's [signature abilities](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/signature-ability), using the host's modifiers for any power rolls. The handmaiden has the same [Stability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/stability) as the host. If the handmaiden or host is [force moved](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement), the other moves with them. While emerged, the handmaiden can be targeted independently of the host. The handmaiden can retreat totally within the host's body as a maneuver. If the handmaiden dies, their remains separate from the host.

The [Find a Cure](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/project/find-a-cure) downtime project in Draw Steel: Heroes can be used to find a cure that removes a handmaiden from a host. The cure kills the handmaiden when consumed.

effects.effect: When the bloodlord is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), they spray burning blood. Each creature [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to the bloodlord takes 3 fire damage.
At the end of each of their turns, the bloodlord can take 10 damage to end one effect on them that can be ended by a saving throw. This damage can't be reduced in any way.

Each target gains 10 temporary [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) and can move up to their speed. Then each non-[minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) target can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike).
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Advance!
features.target: Self and each ally in the area

effects.effect: Until the end of the encounter, the bloodlord surrounds themself with a storm of flying skulls. Any enemy who enters the area for the first time in a round or starts their turn there takes 8 corruption damage and takes a bane on their next power roll until the start of their next turn.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Until the end of the encounter, the bloodlord is wreathed in black flames. Whenever any [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) enemy [grabs](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) the bloodlord or uses a melee ability against them, that enemy takes 5 corruption damage.

effects.effect: The kingfissure worm can take two turns each round. They can't take turns consecutively.
effects.name: Solo Turns

effects.effect: The kingfissure worm has three tongues. Each tongue is a 5 x 1 line within 1 square of the kingfissure worm, has 35 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) and psychic immunity all, and can't be [force moved](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement). Each tongue enables the kingfissure worm to [grab](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) one size 3 or smaller creature or object. A tongue can be targeted by abilities only while it has a target [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed).

effects.tier3: 22 damage; M < 5 [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) and the target takes a bane on the Escape Grab maneuver

effects.effect: The kingfissure worm must have one or more tongues to use this ability. As a maneuver, the kingfissure worm can [pull](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to two creatures [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) this way [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to them.
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Tongue Grab
features.target: One creature or object per tongue

effects.tier3: 25 damage; the target is swallowed (see Swallowed)

effects.effect: When the kingfissure worm uses the Charge main action, they ignore [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain) and automatically destroy mundane size 3 and smaller objects in the path of their charge. The first time the kingfissure worm moves through a creature's space during this charge, that creature takes 8 damage and is [pushed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 3 squares.
The target is swallowed (see Swallowed).
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The kingfissure worm can use this maneuver only while they have a creature or object [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed). The worm slams the [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) creature or object against the target, dealing 13 damage to both. If this ability is used at range, it deals an extra 5 damage and the [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed) creature or object is released.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: The kingfissure worm deals 5 damage to the creature or object the tongue had [grabbed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/grabbed), releases that creature or object, then pulls the damaged tongue back into their mouth.
effects.name: Effect

features.name: Tearing Recoil
features.trigger: A tongue takes damage that doesn't reduce it to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina).

effects.effect: The kingfissure worm has line of effect only within 3 squares However, they ignore concealment for creatures touching the ground and don't need line of effect to use abilities against those creatures.

A creature swallowed by the kingfissure worm is [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) and takes 1d6 acid damage at the start of every turn. If the worm takes 25 or more damage in a single round from swallowed creatures, they immediately regurgitate all creatures they have swallowed, who land [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) in unoccupied spaces within 3 squares of the kingfissure worm.
The kingfissure worm can [burrow](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/burrow) through stone. When the worm burrows, they create a stable size 3 tunnel in the squares they move through.

The kingfissure worm can't be [frightened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/frightened) or knocked [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone). While the worm is [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) or [slowed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/slowed), they take a −2 penalty to speed instead of suffering those conditions' usual effects on speed.
Each target must be on the ground.

effects.effect: The area becomes a 10-square-deep fissure in the earth. Each target makes an **Agility test**.

effects.tier1: 10 damage; the target falls into the fissure, lands [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone), and can't stand (EoT)
effects.tier2: 10 damage; the target is knocked [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone) and left hanging at the edge of the area
effects.tier3: The target [shifts](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area.

effects.effect: The terranova ignores [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain). Additionally, they don't need [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to use abilities against creatures touching the ground.

If the terranova is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), they can make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) before dying. If the target of the free strike is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), the terranova is reduced to 1 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) instead.

effects.effect: At the end of each of their turns, the maestro can take 5 damage to end one effect on them that can be ended by a [saving throw](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw). This damage can't be reduced in any way.
Each target can [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to their speed or take the Defend action.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Until the end of their next turn, the target halves any damage they take, gains a +4 damage bonus to [strikes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), and has their speed doubled.
effects.name: Effect

effects.effect: Each target stands, makes a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike), then falls dead again. Any ally of the targets can use Ready Rodent as a free triggered action once in conjunction with these free strikes.
effects.name: Effect
